* fix(jsx): isolate context per request during async SSR

`createContext` kept provided values on a process-wide shared stack and
left them there while an async child component was suspended. Two
overlapping SSR requests entering the same Provider then operated on the
same stack, so `useContext()` after an `await` could return another
in-flight request's value — leaking rendered output and authorization
decisions across requests.

Context values are now held in a per-render store. The store is carried
across `await` boundaries with AsyncLocalStorage when the runtime
provides it (Node.js >= 20.16, Deno, Bun, Cloudflare Workers with
nodejs_compat); on runtimes without it the store is kept only during
synchronous execution and a post-`await` read falls back to the context
default value (the same fail-safe React's request storage uses) instead
of leaking another request's value. Every async suspension point
(deferred JSXNode render, Suspense, ErrorBoundary, childrenToString)
captures and re-establishes the store through a shared capture/resume
helper.

* fix(jsx): render ErrorBoundary fallback only once

`caught` was declared `const` and never set, so the dedup guard was dead
code: when several children rejected, `catchCallback` ran the fallback —
and `onError` — once per rejection. Set the flag on the first catch so
the fallback renders and reports exactly once.
